name: Twilio
description: Typed Twilio SMS/MMS, call and recording controls, account and phone metadata, Messaging Services, Verify and usage pages.

permissions.description: Fixed credential-free HTTPS routes on api.twilio.com, messaging.twilio.com and verify.twilio.com; external Account SID/Auth Token or API key SID/secret via Basic Authorization. Provider permissions, consent, sender registration and billing apply. Sends, calls, recording and Verify mutations require exact confirmation and zero retries. No account signup, credential creation, OAuth/refresh, media downloads, webhooks/listeners, arbitrary hosts or background polling.
